category_title: Individuals with SIB masking social functions under standard assessment conditions
minimal_context: The student is in a padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves while the tutor presents an instructional task using a three-step prompting procedure.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to work. Please sort these blocks into the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits in the padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves, looking away from the instructional stimuli.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Watch me do it. Pick up the block and put it in the bin like this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the blocks and begins hitting his arms against his legs at a high rate despite the canvas sleeves.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me help you. I am going to guide your hands to put the block in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Immediately begins hitting himself in the head, kicking his legs against his torso, and attempting to dig his nails into his skin.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to work. Please sort these blocks into the bin.

STUDENT: (Sits in the padded treatment room wearing canvas sleeves, looking away from the instructional stimuli.)

TUTOR: Watch me do it. Pick up the block and put it in the bin like this.

STUDENT: (Ignores the blocks and begins hitting his arms against his legs at a high rate despite the canvas sleeves.)

TUTOR: Let me help you. I am going to guide your hands to put the block in the bin.

STUDENT: (Immediately begins hitting himself in the head, kicking his legs against his torso, and attempting to dig his nails into his skin.)

task.content: Instructions were presented using a three-step prompting procedure that included vocal instruction, modeling, and physical guidance

context.environment: Padded treatment rooms with a one-way observation window
context.social_setting: Sessions under the supervision of doctoral-level Board Certified Behavior Analysts

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When instructions were presented using a three-step prompting procedure
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Head-directed SIB, such as hitting oneself in the head or banging head against a surface; body-directed SIB, such as hitting or kicking the torso, arms, or legs; and skin-directed SIB, which included behavior that damaged the skin barrier, such as scratching, pinching, or digging nails into skin

behavior_patterns.condition: Regardless of the level of stimulation present
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: SIB occurs at high rates across conditions
